verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Release Pipelines that move flags through stages with "triggers and actions", a manual kill switch, and an experimentation engine for reading A/B results. None of the evidence shows rollout triggers driven by health or regression metrics, or an automatic rollback when a metric degrades. The kill switch and pipeline automation are adjacent features, not metric-guarded auto-rollback.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
